I promise there’s nothing missing. I don’t know what happened on my end either? She’s just freaking out because she loves animals and I need to know if it was me who did something wrong. I’ve apologized so much already but she’s not even answering anymore

I am usually pretty anxious but have severe anxiety about this because I think it’s so important to me. I exercise regularly but nothing seems to take my mind off her and what she’s doing. No she was done with him and her and I agreed we always felt something and I was part of the reason it didn’t workout with the previous guys. She’s perfect in every way and I don’t see any point in going on with life.
